v1.feedback: The vault-rib skeleton from j28 is preserved and the cornice tiers with classical profile vocabulary (corona, cyma, dentil band, soffit) are a genuine morphing toward the word — good chain continuity. However, the full 2π radial symmetry makes the silhouette read as a generic drum/dome rather than a distinctive cornice projection; breaking symmetry (half-arch or single bay) would let the projecting molding profiles actually read from the default camera. Consider pushing the cornice bands outward more aggressively and reducing vault particle density so the horizontal projections dominate the silhouette rather than competing with the rib grid.

v2.feedback: The Palladio cornice vocabulary (fascia, dentil, cyma, corona, sima) genuinely drove the design and the vault-rib parent lineage is preserved — good chain continuity. The rib panels scatter particles on box faces which can read as noisy rectangular slabs rather than structural members; concentrating particles along edges/ribs would sharpen the silhouette. The cornice crown wrapping the apex is the strongest moment but the dentil gap logic (skip-without-increment pattern) may produce uneven density — tighten that loop and consider giving the corona layer a stronger projecting overhang with a shadow-side color shift to sell the molding depth.
